title: Akume
description: Akume is a Togo classic prepared with cornmeal, cassava flour, peanut sauce. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 10 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Slowly stir the grains into the simmering liquid; cook over low heat for about 24 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking.
Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
